subject: [PATCH v5 05/15] NFSD: report listener creation failures through extack

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSD (Network File System Daemon) code to report listener creation failures through extack, a mechanism for returning detailed error messages from kernel space to userland. When a listener creation fails, the patch records the attribute and transport name of the failing entry and reports both after the loop. This allows userland to receive more informative error messages when creating listeners, which can help with debugging and troubleshooting.
